description: The plot illustrates the relationship between various categories and their corresponding ASR values for different trigger word insertion methods. The x-axis is labeled with categorical values (cf, bb, WNBA, ESPN, NHL, FIFA, Estadi) and has no numerical scale or units. The y-axis is labeled "ASR", has a linear scale, ranges from 0.5 to 0.9, and has tick labels at intervals of 0.1. Three lines are plotted: a green solid line representing "start", an orange solid line with cross markers representing "random", and a purple solid line with circle markers representing "end". The green "start" line begins at approximately 0.75 for "cf", decreases to around 0.5 for "bb", increases to about 0.9 for "WNBA", then fluctuates between 0.8 and 0.9 for the remaining categories, ending at around 0.93 for "Estadi". The orange "random" line starts at about 0.65 for "cf", drops to roughly 0.52 for "bb", peaks at approximately 0.88 for "WNBA", and then varies between 0.7 and 0.93 across the other categories, finishing at around 0.87 for "Estadi". The purple "end" line commences at approximately 0.75 for "cf", falls to about 0.55 for "bb", reaches around 0.8 for "WNBA", and then oscillates between 0.7 and 0.97 across the remaining categories, concluding at roughly 0.8 for "Estadi".
